facts.fact: 五年前的今天牧场早该挂满南瓜灯饰；如今门廊空空——Pops 已逝，万圣节装饰绝迹
facts.anchor: Five years ago, the ranch would have been covered in pumpkins by now.

facts.fact: 每天早晨她都在 Blueberry 隔间里坐近一小时，向马抱怨它听不懂的烦心事——马只是听，这就够了
facts.anchor: Before leaving, I spent nearly an hour in the barn with Blueberry. Like I did every morning.

facts.fact: 车祸后她住院数月做复健，Pops 请来佐治亚最好的马兽医救回 Blueberry；人与马都带着伤、都要重建信任
facts.anchor: While I spent months in hospitals and physical therapy, Pops had tracked down one of the best equine vets in Georgia and done everything possible to save her.

facts.fact: 小镇只知道她出了严重车祸、职业生涯结束——不知道她少了一条腿；穿牛仔裤、不离牧场，把秘密守住
facts.anchor: What they didn’t know was that I came home missing a leg.

facts.fact: Pops 陪她熬过康复训练后某天早晨心脏骤停——无预警、无告别；已逝五年
facts.anchor: Then one morning his heart simply gave out.

facts.fact: 失腿改变身体、失 Pops 改变其余一切——有些早晨她认不出镜中那个女人
facts.anchor: Losing a leg changed my body, but losing Pops had changed everything else.

facts.fact: Pops 死后多数帮工跳去更大的牧场；冷藏罐修不起、饲料年年涨价、南牧场围栏半数待换——农场靠固执月月续命
facts.anchor: After Pops died, most of the ranch hands left for bigger operations. The dairy cooler needed repairs I couldn’t afford.

facts.fact: 送奶日卡车在半路彻底抛锚：雷雨、一格信号、电话全失败；Jones Automotive 在两英里外——她决定冒雨走进镇（章末）
facts.anchor: The truck rolled to a stop with a final shudder.
